headline: India says it does not support remarks of ousted PM Sheikh Hasina
summary: Indian Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that the Indian government does not endorse the statements made by the former Bangladeshi prime minister.
details: Indian Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal announced during a press conference in Delhi that the Indian government does not approve of the remarks made by ousted former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.
The statement comes as a clear distancing of the Indian government from the views expressed by the former leader of Bangladesh.
Jaiswal emphasized that the statements made by Sheikh Hasina do not represent the official position or endorsement of the Indian government.
This development highlights the evolving diplomatic dynamics between India and Bangladesh following the change in leadership in Dhaka.
caption:
India has officially distanced itself from the statements of ousted Bangladeshi PM Sheikh Hasina.

Indian Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal announced during a press conference in Delhi that the Indian government does not approve of the remarks made by ousted former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

The statement comes as a clear distancing of the Indian government from the views expressed by the former leader of Bangladesh.

Jaiswal emphasized that the statements made by Sheikh Hasina do not represent the official position or endorsement of the Indian government.

This development highlights the evolving diplomatic dynamics between India and Bangladesh following the change in leadership in Dhaka.

Source: Prothom Alo, Somoy News, Dhaka Tribune

headline: Investigation reveals underworld links in high-profile killings
summary: A string of high-profile murders has been linked to organized crime networks, according to recent findings.
details: Investigations into a series of high-profile killings have uncovered connections to the criminal underworld.
The findings suggest that organized crime networks were involved in the execution of these targeted murders.
Authorities are continuing to probe the depth of these links to identify all perpetrators and masterminds.
This development highlights the intersection between criminal elements and high-stakes violence in the region.
